blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate Impeachment Court on Wednesday let corporate counsel Suzette Balucanag-Punay testify for the defense despite the prosecution challenging her authority to represent two companies linked to Vice President Sara Duterte. Balucanag-Punay, the corporate counsel of GenCorp Industries Inc. and Metro City Chow Foods Corp., was presented by defense lawyer Justin Nicol […]...
